fields.description: Weekly issue featuring extensive coverage and satire surrounding the Lions convention in Greater Miami, including editorials urging hospitality and criticizing increased policing and "clamping down" in Dade County. Reports and commentary address Miami municipal election results and the incoming city commission, concerns about gun-toting and municipal court practices, and criticism of a Dade County/Miami Beach bond issue advanced without advertised public notice. Includes advertisements and visitor information (tours, dining, entertainment) for Lions and other travelers in Miami and Miami Beach.
